term: marks of a choice require a personal source
definition: If a frame has the #742 marks of a choice at a world, some base reason is the existence fact of a bearer with the supplied flag. It is the bridge a selection argument for will would need.
note: Open and unattributed. The flag is an uninterpreted parameter, so the bridge states a demand and not a test of personhood. See docs/notes/physical-ground-468.md.
